validate_environment_higgs_quantizer: validate the GPU, CUDA, accelerate, FLUTE, and hadamard environment requirements for HIGGS quantization
load_higgs_quantized_model: load a prequantized HIGGS model by setting device_map to CUDA devices only
dequantize_higgs_model: dequantize a HIGGS-quantized model back to full precision using the _dequantize method
check_higgs_quantizer_serializable: check if the HIGGS quantizer produces serializable output for model saving
update_higgs_quantizer_dtype: update the HIGGS quantizer dtype to torch.float16 or torch.bfloat16 only
